WITH top AS (SELECT instrumentref, MAX(holdingpct) AS top_weight FROM holdings GROUP BY instrumentref)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS focused_alpha_leaders
FROM funds f JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
JOIN top t ON t.instrumentref = f.tickersym
WHERE r.alpha5y > 0 AND t.top_weight > 0.08

WITH a AS (
  SELECT f.tickersym,
         ((p.r3y - p.benchr3y)::float8 / r.volatility3y) - ((f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp)::float8 * 10) AS amv
  FROM funds f JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
  JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
  WHERE p.r3y IS NOT NULL AND p.benchr3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y <> 0
    AND f.expensenet IS NOT NULL AND f.benchmarkexp IS NOT NULL),
s AS (SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amv > 0) / COUNT(*) AS pct_positive_amv FROM a)
SELECT a.tickersym, ROUND(a.amv::numeric, 4) AS amv, ROUND(s.pct_positive_amv::numeric, 4) AS pct_positive_amv
FROM a CROSS JOIN s ORDER BY a.amv DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT f.productclass, COUNT(*) AS fund_count,
       ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(r.alpha3y, f.turnoverratio)::numeric, 4) AS alpha_turnover_slope,
       ROUND(REGR_R2(r.alpha3y, f.turnoverratio)::numeric, 4) AS r_squared
FROM funds f JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
WHERE f.productclass IS NOT NULL AND r.alpha3y IS NOT NULL AND f.turnoverratio IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.productclass HAVING COUNT(*) > 25
ORDER BY alpha_turnover_slope DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT ROUND(AVG(((p.r3y - p.benchr3y)::float8 / r.volatility3y)
             * (p.positiveyears::float8 / (p.positiveyears + p.negativeyears) * 100) / 100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_cair
FROM performance p JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = p.productref
WHERE p.r3y IS NOT NULL AND p.benchr3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y IS NOT NULL AND r.volatility3y <> 0
  AND p.positiveyears IS NOT NULL AND p.negativeyears IS NOT NULL AND (p.positiveyears + p.negativeyears) > 0

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.tickersym, f.shortlabel,
         ((p.low52w + p.lowdelta) - p.low52w)::float8 / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100 AS price_position
  FROM funds f JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
  WHERE f.turnoverratio < 0.3 AND (f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) < 0)
SELECT tickersym, shortlabel, ROUND(price_position::numeric, 8) AS price_position
FROM x WHERE price_position < 25
ORDER BY price_position ASC LIMIT 100

WITH hq AS (
  SELECT b.fundlink,
         SUM(b.allocationpct) FILTER (WHERE r.credit_scoringmark IN ('us_government', 'aaa', 'aa'))::float8 AS hq_alloc,
         SUM(b.allocationpct)::float8 AS total_alloc
  FROM bond_allocations b JOIN bond_ratings r ON r.ratekey = b.ratinglink
  GROUP BY b.fundlink),
x AS (
  SELECT f.tickersym, f.shortlabel, f.yieldrate::float8 / f.expensenet AS yter, hq.hq_alloc
  FROM funds f JOIN hq ON hq.fundlink = f.tickersym
  WHERE f.expensenet > 0 AND f.yieldrate::float8 / f.expensenet > 15
    AND hq.hq_alloc / NULLIF(hq.total_alloc, 0) > 0.6)
SELECT tickersym, shortlabel, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY yter * hq_alloc DESC) AS premier_rank, yter * hq_alloc AS sies
FROM x ORDER BY sies DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN f.pe_ratio IS NOT NULL AND f.pb_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN 'Transparent' ELSE 'Opaque' END AS valuation_group,
       COUNT(*) AS fund_count,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.r1y)::numeric, 4) AS median_1y_return
FROM funds f LEFT JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
GROUP BY 1

WITH o AS (
  SELECT calendaryear, fundperf - categoryperf AS outperformance
  FROM annual_returns
  WHERE portfolioref = 'AADR' AND fundperf IS NOT NULL AND categoryperf IS NOT NULL)
SELECT calendaryear, outperformance,
       LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS prev_outperformance,
       outperformance - LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS yoy_change
FROM o ORDER BY calendaryear
